subject: Renewal + multi-region capacity increase / cross-border invoicing pathing
messages:
From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@healthsync.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:02:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase for EU regions

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — HealthSync is preparing to renew our Redwood commitment and want to expand capacity for EU regions (additional 40% peak GPU capacity for Q3/Q4). We’d like to move to an 18-month term to align with our procurement cycle and are planning split invoicing between UK/Ireland entity and our EU headquarters.

Attached is the PO draft for the renewal (HealthSync_PO_v1.pdf). A couple of asks on our side:
- Can Redwood issue a UK VAT-inclusive invoice to HealthSync Ltd (UK entity) for the first tranche and an EU invoice to HealthSync B.V. for the remainder?
- Is there a recommended acceptance/onboarding timeline if we need the extra capacity by Aug 1?
- Any impact to marketplace private-offer flow vs direct PO? We prefer to keep this in AWS Marketplace for consolidated billing but need guidance on billing entities.

Happy to jump on a short call this week.

Thanks,
Sandra
Sandra Liu
Head of Procurement, HealthSync
procurement@healthsync.io

--
Attachment: HealthSync_PO_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@healthsync.io>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase for EU regions

Hi Sandra — really appreciate the clear ask and the PO.

Short answers up front:
- We can support split invoicing via a staged acceptance and private-offer path on AWS Marketplace; you’ll need two invoices issued to separate legal entities (we’ll work with marketplace billing to route correctly).
- We can target an operational acceptance by Jul 15 to hit Aug 1 capacity if we start the private-offer procurement by Mar 24.
- Using the Marketplace private offer simplifies consolidated cloud billing on your side, but it does add a DocuSign signature step and a marketplace acceptance window.

I’ve copied Naomi (partner ops) so she can engage AWS marketplace liaison, and I’ll loop in our finance and marketplace team for the invoice split.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll forward your PO internally for billing/legal confirmation (cc’d).
2) We’ll surface an acceptance/tranche plan and a DocuSign link within 3 business days.
3) If you’re available, I can schedule a 30m working call Tue or Wed next week to confirm entity details and timeline.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@healthsync.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase for EU regions

Thanks Kimberly — Tue 10am ET works for us.

A couple of clarifications to surface before the call:
- The UK entity will require VAT on their invoice (HealthSync Ltd). The Dutch BV is VAT-registered and needs invoices that do not double-VAT (we’ll provide VAT IDs).
- We will need invoices on quarterly tranches (three invoices across the 18-month term) if possible — procurement prefers tranches aligned with our fiscal quarters.
- Can Redwood confirm whether any tax withholding will be applied for the UK entity (so we can reconcile with our tax team)?

I can bring our treasury lead on the call to confirm the VAT IDs.

Sandra

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + capacity increase for EU regions — HealthSync PO v2 request

Team — forwarding HealthSync’s ask below. Key points: 18-month term, +40% EU capacity by Aug 1, split invoices between UK Ltd and Dutch BV, quarterly tranches, VAT handling questions. They prefer Marketplace private offer if it keeps billing consolidated on their cloud invoicing.

Questions for ops & finance:
- Marissa: can we accept a PO and create two separate invoice recipients in our billing flow (one UK VAT invoice, one EU invoice) for a single private offer? Any payment timing constraints on Marketplace?
- Rishi: confirm whether Redwood needs to register or report any UK VAT or whether we route invoices through marketplace to avoid our tax exposure. Also confirm withholding guidance.
- Priyom: what do we need for acceptance timing and marketplace private-offer creation? If we hit Mar 24 for private-offer submission, can we guarantee a July 15 acceptance?

I attached the updated PO they said they will send (HealthSync_PO_v2.pdf) and the marketplace acceptance checklist we typically use.

Thanks — Kim

--
Attachment: HealthSync_PO_v2.pdf
Attachment: marketplace-acceptance-checklist.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal + capacity increase for EU regions — HealthSync PO v2 request

Thanks Kim — quick plan below (high-level ops + billing path):

1) Marketplace private-offer path: submit private offer by Mar 24 with two invoice recipients configured. We’ve done multi-entity routing on marketplace with a two-recipient mapping (one invoice per legal entity). That typically requires:
   - Purchase order linked to each entity (they’ll need to confirm VAT IDs in the DocuSign envelope).
   - DocuSign: we provide one envelope that contains acceptance and a field for entity designation.

2) Acceptance timeline: if private-offer is submitted Mar 24, we can target internal acceptance testing by Jun 18 and operational acceptance by Jul 12 — that gives ops one week of buffer before Aug 1 rollout.

3) Billing tranches: we can support three quarterly tranches. Marketplace invoices will be generated to the mapped entity at invoice issuance; Redwood finance will issue accounting entries on our side and we’ll send final PDFs to both entities.

4) VAT/withholding: Rishi should confirm, but market experience is that when marketplace is the billing conduit we don’t register in-county for VAT for the customer invoice; the marketplace transmits the invoice. If we invoice directly to a UK legal entity, we may need to include VAT on the invoice.

Action items:
- Marissa: verify we can map two invoice recipients in the Marketplace private-offer UI and confirm any payment window constraints (net30/seat).
- Rishi: provide a short note on VAT/withholding to include in the DocuSign packet for HealthSync’s treasury.
- Kim: schedule Tue 10am call with HealthSync and include AWS rep to speed marketplace acceptance.

I’ll draft the private-offer payload and share by EOD Thu.

— Priyom

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@healthsync.io>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@amazon.com>, naomi.feldman@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com

- We will proceed on the AWS Marketplace private-offer route so HealthSync keeps cloud consolidated billing.

- Rishi will provide a short VAT note for your treasury (expect within 24 hours).
- We’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope that includes entity selection fields and the three quarterly tranche schedule; you’ll receive that by Mon EOD.

Kim
